pageProps.title: God's Quiz Season 3 (2012)
pageProps.review: We present the mysterious development and review of God's Quiz Season 3, where Han Jin-woo confronts his inner self and a new enemy, Phantom, in a plot that is darker and more intricate than previous seasons.
pageProps.content:
## Review The process of Han Jin-woo fighting another ego within himself appears little by little in the flow of major episodes. ```Phantom``` is depicted as a new character in a confrontation, but the character setting feels somewhat forced.
This season is somewhat darker compared to previous seasons.
